user.title: Set up Antiflap
user.description: Create a binary sensor that resists short inactive/request gaps by holding on longer after repeated short gaps.

data_description.input_entity: Entity to apply the Antiflap logic to.
data_description.active_state: Input entity state that means active. Leave blank to use the default (`default: on`).
data_description.free_flaps: How many flaps are ignored before adaptive hold begins. Leave blank to use the default (`default: 0`).
data_description.flap_gap_seconds: Inactive gaps at or below this duration count as flaps when the input becomes active again. Leave blank to use the default (`default: 30 seconds`).
data_description.base_hold_seconds: The first hold duration after the free flaps are exceeded. Leave blank to calculate it from flap gap seconds and minimum base hold seconds (`default: max(ceil(flap_gap_seconds / 4), min_base_hold_seconds) =  max(ceil(30 / 4), 30) = 30 seconds`).
data_description.min_base_hold_seconds: Minimum derived base hold when base hold seconds is blank. Leave blank to use the current flap gap seconds (`default: 30 seconds`).
data_description.hold_factor: Multiplier used to grow each additional hold duration. Leave blank to use the default (`default: 1.5`).
data_description.max_hold_seconds: Maximum hold duration. Leave blank to use the default (`default: 600 seconds`).
data_description.min_on_seconds: Minimum time the Antiflap sensor must stay on after it turns on. Leave blank to use the default (`default: 0 seconds`).
data_description.window_seconds: How long recent flaps are remembered. Leave blank to calculate it from free flaps, flap gap seconds, base hold seconds, hold factor, and maximum hold seconds (`default: 120 seconds`).
